Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Content: To answer questions about `text(Earth's)` history, students looked at rock samples from different layers of the ocean floor. The rock samples contained fossils of very small ocean organisms called forams.

Some of the rock formed during the Cretaceous time period from `145.5` to `65.5` `text(million years)` ago, before an event called the K-T extinction. The rest of the rock formed during the Tertiary time period from `65.5` to `35.4` `text(million years)` ago, after the K-T extinction. In their investigation, the students measured the lengths of the foram fossils in the rock samples. The graphs show the size ranges of the foram fossils in rock samples from `text(each time period)`.
